channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Crise no STF torna reeleição de Alcolumbre no Senado incerta
item.description: The STF crisis and impeachment requests weaken Davi Alcolumbre's Senate reelection prospects, with opposition pressure and uncertain government backing. The Amprev investigation and Banco Master ties are also cited to question his stance.

item.title: PF responde Fachin sobre informações de celular de Vorcaro
item.description: The Federal Police responded to Minister Edson Fachin, stating it preserves the integrity of banker Daniel Vorcaro's phone under formal chain of custody. The agency said it sent a copy of the data to Minister André Mendonça's office in March but ensured the original material remains under its custody. The PF placed itself at the disposal of the Supreme Court for additional clarifications.

item.title: Janja participa de caminhada com candidatos do PT em Brasília
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva joined a walk in support of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s re-election and Leandro Grass’s bid for DF governor, engaging with supporters and singing the ‘Rap do Silva’. The rally also backed Senate candidates Erika Kokay and Leila do Volei, ending with criticism of Celina Leão’s administration.

item.title: Caso Master aponta “intersecção entre bolsonarismo e Vorcaro”, diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad claims the Master Case reveals ties between Bolsonarismo and Daniel Vorcaro, advocating for lifting phone secrecy to expose alleged connections between Jair Bolsonaro and the scheme. He criticizes selective leaks and supports Supreme Court actions.

item.title: 'Dark Horse': ao retirar sigilo de investigação, Dino cita suspeita de que Frias liderou esquema criminoso de desvios
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino declassified investigations into a suspected corruption scheme involving federal deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP), indicating he may have led a criminal scheme involving public fund diversion.

item.title: “Vassalo de Trump”: Renan acusa Flávio de receber financiamento de grupo dos EUA
item.description: Renan Santos accuses Flávio Bolsonaro of receiving funding from Rockbridge Network, a group linked to U.S. Vice President J.D. Vance, involving interests in rare earth minerals in Brazil. The accusation was shared on social media as part of a campaign strategy against the PL candidate. The content was originally published on O Antagonista website.

item.title: Em entrevista a podcast, Augusto Cury diz que doará salário de presidente caso seja eleito
item.description: Augusto Cury, Avante's presidential candidate, stated in a podcast that he will donate his monthly presidential salary (R$ 46,366.19) to two schools and two micro-enterprises. He declared assets worth R$ 240 million and emphasized his political entry is not driven by career ambitions but service to society.

item.title: Seria Lula, como se diz no futebol, um ex-craque em atividade?
item.description: President Lula, still regarded as a political standout, faces criticism for a weaker administration during his third term, marked by strained relations with Congress and declining popularity. Despite readjustment with elite sectors and the PT base, the reelection campaign reveals signs of fatigue and wear, especially amid challenges at the Supreme Court and strong competition from Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Dark Horse: Dino determina entrega de celulares de investigados à PF
item.description: STF Minister Flávio Dino ordered the lifting of secrecy on the investigation into the financing of the film 'Dark Horse' and mandated the transfer of seized phones and computers to the Federal Police for analysis. The investigation suggests possible misuse of parliamentary amendments by federal deputy Mario Frias, with suspicions of money laundering and contract fraud involving companies and cultural institutions. The 'Make Up' operation, launched by the Federal Police, executed 49 search and seizure warrants, including those of Frias and businesswoman Karina da Gama, producer of the film.

item.title: Brasil pode enfrentar ao menos seis ondas de calor até o fim de 2026
item.description: Brazil may face at least six heat waves until the end of 2026, according to a projection based on 47 years of data and influenced by El Niño. The climate phenomenon alters atmospheric circulation, increasing the frequency and intensity of extreme temperatures, with severe impacts on droughts, wildfires, and public health.

item.title: Maioria diz que crise no STF não muda o voto, mostra Datafolha
item.description: Datafolho survey shows that the STF crisis did not change the voting preference of 85% of voters for president. Allegations against minister Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça maintained stability in voting intention, with few voters changing their minds.

item.title: Relatório da Polícia Civil de SP vê 'consistentes suspeitas' de desvio de recursos de contrato de wi-fi para 'Dark Horse'
item.description: A police report from São Paulo alleges misappropriation of funds from the 'WiFi Livre SP' program to finance the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro. The investigation points to Karina Ferreira da Gama, head of Instituto Conhecer Brasil, as the main figure. Irregularities in the contract and suspected public fund laundering were identified.

item.title: PF diz a Fachin que pode enviar dados do celular de Vorcaro a ministros
item.description: The Federal Police told Supreme Court President Edson Fachin it has technical capabilities to share copies of data from ex-banker Daniel Vorcaro's phone with other justices, including Alexandre de Moraes, ahead of a session deciding on an investigation into Moraes in the 'Master Case'.

item.title: Dark Horse: Dino retira sigilo e autoriza PF a ter acesso a íntegra da investigação de SP
item.description: Supreme Court minister Flávio Dino lifted the confidentiality of the investigation into the funding of the film Dark Horse, a biographical documentary about Jair Bolsonaro, authorizing the Federal Police to access all materials from the inquiry conducted in São Paulo. The ruling also orders the delivery of seized phone data and documents to the PF, based on suspicions of a financial circuit involving parliamentary amendments. Dino acknowledges a jurisprudential shift regarding investigative confidentiality but warns of debates over the presumption of innocence and investigative efficiency.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos à Presidência da República do Brasil nas eleições 2026
item.description: The official list of presidential candidates for the 2026 Brazilian elections was finalized with twelve nominees, including Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) seeking a third term and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) representing the Bolsonaro legacy. Former president Jair Bolsonaro is ineligible due to his conviction for attempting a coup d'etat. Voting takes place on October 4th, with a potential runoff on October 25th.

item.title: Dino critica “morosidades inexplicáveis” em investigações
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino criticized public officials who promote 'cover-ups' and 'inexplicable delays' in investigations, declassifying the inquiry into Go Up Entertainment, the producer of Jair Bolsonaro's biographical film. He defended transparency to combat selective leaks and judicial analysis delays.

item.title: Após diganóstico de pneumonia e internação em hospital de SP, Ronaldo Caiado terá alta neste domingo
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the presidential candidate from PSD, was diagnosed with pneumonia and hospitalized at the Vila Nova Star Hospital in São Paulo. His campaign announced that he will be discharged on Sunday and that his clinical progress is positive. In a video, Caiado emphasized that he is receiving appropriate treatment and that his recovery is progressing well.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram a distância entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro após números da semana
item.description: Recent polls show a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, with minor numerical variations across institutes. Lula holds a slight lead in the first round, though the gap is also within the margin of error in some surveys. Augusto Cury has declined but remains in third place.

item.title: A saia justa de Ciro Gomes com Flávio Bolsonaro no Ceará
item.description: Ciro Gomes, PSDB candidate for Ceará governor, avoids aligning with Flávio Bolsonaro and right-wing figures to prevent nationalizing the debate and distancing from the LulaxBolsonaro polarization. Elmano de Freitas campaign keeps linking him to the Bolsonaro family, while Ciro pursues a proactive agenda and avoids commenting on the STF crisis. In the latest poll, the PT candidate leads with 47% against Ciro's 46% in the runoff.

item.title: Dino diz que investigação alude a Mario Frias como liderança em ‘suposta arquitetura criminosa’
item.description: STF Minister Flávio Dino ordered an investigation into alleged 'criminal architecture' involving federal deputy Mario Frias, linked to public fund misappropriation through parliamentary amendments and companies like Go Up and Complexsys. The Federal Police points to financial movements between Frias, ICB, ANC, and other entities suggesting a possible money laundering scheme.

item.title: Dino levanta sigilo de material da polícia de SP de produtora de Dark Horse
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino decided to lift the secrecy of all material shared by the São Paulo Civil Police regarding the investigation involving the producer of the film 'Dark Horse', a biographical film about former President Jair Messias Bolsonaro.

item.title: Datafolha: veja a aprovação de Lula em SP, MG, RJ, PE e DF
item.description: Datafolha released approval ratings for President Lula in five states: São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Pernambuco, and the Federal District. Pernambuco shows the best result with 46% positive, while the Federal District has the worst at 26%. São Paulo leads with 48% negative.

item.title: Crise do judiciário e os efeitos sobre a sociedade (por Gaudêncio Torquato)
item.description: The article analyzes how the Brazilian judiciary crisis affects society, highlighting issues of efficiency, legitimacy and integrity, with impacts on the economy, politics and the citizen-state relationship. Internal conflicts in the STF, such as disputes between ministers, worsen the crisis of trust in justice.

item.title: Lula fará live nas redes sociais neste domingo às 18h
item.description: Lula will hold a live stream on social media this Sunday at 6 PM, calling supporters to mobilize. He is expected to address the Banco Master scandal and reinforce the need for unbiased investigations. In his electoral program, he advocates punishing everyone involved regardless of political ties.

item.title: PIB sobe só 1% em 2027, mas ajuste fortalecerá retomada, diz Megale
item.description: Caio Megale, chief economist at XP, forecasts 1% GDP growth in 2027 but expects a fiscal adjustment that year to boost recovery in 2028. He advocates government spending cuts and hints at a 25bps interest rate cut.

item.title: A nova pesquisa presidencial do Datafolha no terceiro maior colégio eleitoral do Nordeste
item.description: A new Datafolha poll will measure voting intentions in Ceará for the 2026 elections, covering presidential, gubernatorial, and senatorial races. The survey includes spontaneous and stimulated questions, testing names like Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Ciro Gomes, among others, and assessing approval of the federal government and voter decisions.

item.title: Flávio cancela agendas de campanha neste domingo em SP por causa de fortes chuvas na região
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro canceled his campaign events scheduled for Sunday in Presidente Prudente (SP) due to heavy rains in the region. The events, which included a joint appearance with Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, were postponed and will be rescheduled at an appropriate time. Bolsonaro will stay in Brasília (DF) with no public agenda on Sunday.

item.title: Mãe de Celina Leão é internada e governadora cancela agendas deste domingo
item.description: Governor Celina Leão canceled today's campaign events after her mother was hospitalized with chest pains. Running mate Gustavo Rocha will attend the scheduled appearances. The candidate will stay with her family during the hospitalization.

item.title: Palmeiras vence São Paulo e dorme na liderança do Brasileirão
item.description: Palmeiras defeated São Paulo 2-0 in the São Paulo derby, temporarily taking the lead in the Brazilian Championship. Goals from Murilo and Vitor Roque strengthened their campaign, and the team now prepares for the Libertadores semifinals against LDU. The result kept them at the top of the table until the Flamengo vs Corinthians match.

item.title: Vídeo: Daniela Mercury faz provocação ao filme Dark Horse no Rock in Rio
item.description: Daniela Mercury provoked the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro, during her Rock in Rio performance, bringing a person dressed as a black horse distributing fake money on stage. The act was a critique of the film's funding, which allegedly came from dubious sources linked to the founder of Banco Master, Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: A preocupação com a voz de Lula
item.description: Lula postponed a campaign stop in Florianópolis, originally scheduled for today, after attending election events in Porto Alegre and Curitiba. The rescheduled date is next Friday, keeping the momentum of his electoral itinerary. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Crise no STF tem pouco efeito sobre eleição, indica Datafolha
item.description: Datafolha survey reveals that 85% of voters say the STF crisis has not influenced their presidential voting intention. The exchange of messages between Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro apparently did not change most respondents' electoral decisions. The research was released on October 12.

item.title: João Gomes e Milo J se encontram nos bastidores do Rock in Rio: 'tenho um amigo internacional'
item.description: João Gomes and Milo J met backstage at Rock in Rio, celebrating international friendship. The Argentine made his Brazilian debut to applause, while João Gomes surprised fans with a visit from Mestrinho during his set. Their meeting sparked positive comments and collaboration requests.

item.title: Sigilo pró-Flávio (por Mary Zaidan)
item.description: The partial breaking of secrecy in the Master investigation revealed that Flávio Bolsonaro is officially under investigation by the Federal Police for suspected money laundering, foreign exchange evasion, and corruption related to the alleged funding of a biographical film about former President Jair Bolsonaro. Despite allegations and audio evidence, Flávio repeatedly denied any involvement, lying about meetings with jailed banker Daniel Vorcaro. The initial secrecy surrounding the PF investigation, combined with judicial secrecy imposed by the STF, sparked criticism over the delay and preferential treatment given to a presidential candidate.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio questionam coincidência de data em decisão de Dino
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro question the coincidence between Moraes' meeting with Alcolumbre and Dino's decision regarding Dark Horse case operations. The ruling was signed on September 3rd, one day after the meeting between the two ministers, raising suspicions of using judicial actions to damage the PL candidate.

item.title: O ministro que está por trás da ofensiva de Lula contra as bets
item.description: A recent article speculates about a potential provisional measure by the Lula administration to tighten regulations on high-value betting operations. The piece suggests the Minister of Economy is coordinating this effort without official confirmation.

item.title: Pesquisa Datafolha mostra a distância entre Lula e Flávio nos três maiores colégios eleitorais do país
item.description: Datafolha surveys show Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of Lula in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo, but the PT candidate leads in Minas Gerais in the second round. The gaps between candidates range from one to eight percentage points across the three largest electoral colleges.

item.title: STF transmitirá ao vivo a sessão sobre vínculo entre Moraes e Vorcaro
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court will livestream a session analyzing a Federal Police report investigating alleged connections between Minister Alexandre de Moraes and former banker Daniel Vorcaro. Justices will vote on whether to authorize an investigation into Moraes, following disputes over the procedural irregularity of the inquiry led by Minister André Mendonça.

item.title: Após tracking, campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro aposta no voto útil para vencer Lula no 1º turno
item.description: Following a tracking poll showing an advantage over Lula in the second round, Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign bets on strategic voting to attract right-wing voters from other candidates and win already in the first round.

item.title: Brasil x Argentina no Sul-Americano de vôlei feminino 2026: horário e onde assistir
item.description: The Brazilian women's volleyball team faces Argentina this Sunday at 12 PM at Maracanãzinho in the final South American tournament match. The leading team with 12 points competes for the Olympic berth to Los Angeles 2028. The winner secures the continental title and Olympic qualification.

item.title: Estudo mostra que 69% dos eleitores não são polarizados
item.description: A study by FESPSP reveals that 69% of Brazilian voters do not exhibit strict affective polarization, meaning they do not combine positive support for their group with rejection of the opposing side. The research, comparing data from 2006 and 2026, uses a bidimensional model to measure emotions, assessing positive and negative affective dimensions independently. Despite the strengthening of Lula and Bolsonaro as political references, affective polarization involves only a minority of voters.

item.title: Mario Frias diz que patrocínio do Master a “Dark Horse” não é crime
item.description: Federal deputy Mario Frias (PL-SP) argued that the Banco Master sponsorship of the film “Dark Horse”, a biopic about Jair Bolsonaro, does not constitute a crime unless there is a promise of official act or benefit in exchange. He emphasized the lack of evidence that Flávio Bolsonaro offered political favors to Daniel Vorcaro, noting that previous investigations into other Bank Master sponsorships were not initiated. Frias questioned the motives behind the investigations, suggesting they may be used as a political weapon during the electoral period.

item.title: A queixa de Gilmar, Dino e Moraes a Lula
item.description: Gilmar Mendes, Flávio Dino, and Alexandre de Moraes voiced dissatisfaction with Lula over lack of communication within the government. The complaint was delivered directly to the president last week, according to an exclusive report. Full content requires subscription access.

item.title: Defesa de Flávio tentou concentrar processos sobre Dark Horse nas mãos de André Mendonça, no STF
item.description: The defense of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro attempted to consolidate investigations into the Dark Horse film at the STF under Minister André Mendonça, but President Edson Fachin maintained the split between the cabinets of Mendonça and Flávio Dino. The requests aimed to unify cases regarding film funding and parliamentary amendments, but were rejected.

item.title: Indecisos passam a orientar a movimentação das campanhas de Lula e Flávio na reta final
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are stepping up their campaigns in Brazil's Southern states, where the government is widely disapproved of and there is a large share of undecided voters who could sway the 2026 election outcome.

item.title: Polarização em ponto de ebulição: o Datafolha de Lula e a PF contra o clã
item.description: Latest Datafolha poll shows Lula leading at 39% versus 35% for Flávio Bolsonaro, a relief for the presidency after a tough week at the STF, though low-income voters and seniors risk abstaining. Meanwhile, PF investigates Flávio for four crimes tied to the Dark Horse documentary funding, undermining the Bolsonaro clan's narrative.

item.title: Maria Bethânia faz o ‘L’ e declara: ‘Eu voto Lula presidente’
item.description: Maria Bethânia declared support for Lula during the Coala Festival in São Paulo, making an 'L' gesture with her hand and saying 'I vote Lula president.' The singer was the festival's main attraction, performing career hits.

item.title: Democracia en venta
item.description: Donald Trump proposed, during the Republican Convention in Dallas, to pay $5,000 to each of the 250 million Brazilian voters with suffrage if Republicans win the largest majority in the 2026 elections, a move interpreted as an attempt to buy an entire election. The proposal has sparked debates about campaign finance, political ethics, and electoral dynamics. Magazine articles and experts analyze the risks to democracy and a potential blue wave in the midterm elections.

item.title: La corrupción monopoliza el debate en la campaña electoral de Brasil
item.description: Brazil prepares for 2026 elections with corruption as the central issue, following Bolsonaro's conviction for conspiring against constitutional order. The debate is dominated by scandals similar to Lava Jato, with many familiar faces in the race.

item.title: Cuatro horas de deliberación para suspender el voto a miles de nacionalizados por la ‘ley de nietos’
item.description: The Spanish Supreme Court deliberated on precautionary measures regarding the 'grandchildren law', which may suspend the vote of thousands of naturalized citizens. Judge Luis Díez-Picazo spoke with Vox's legal coordinator, Jorge Buxadé, before the hearing. The case raises controversies over civil and electoral rights.
